connector.name: Microsoft Planner by mspstack
connector.registryDescription: Microsoft Planner MCP server - plans, buckets, tasks via Microsoft Graph, ETags handled
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-planner. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the mspstack account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: MS_TENANT_ID

env.name: MS_CLIENT_SECRET
env.description: Entra app registration client secret (app needs Tasks.ReadWrite.All, GroupMember.Read.All, User.Read.All application permissions)

env.name: PLANNER_ADVANCED_TOOLSET
env.description: true/1 registers the advanced toolset (graph_get, graph_find_endpoint) — a read-only escape hatch limited to /planner, /groups, /users
